description: The launch handshake (ADR-010 §5, amending ADR-005 L3). A launcher starts the game with -VeyraLaunchCode=stdin and pipes for its standard input and output. The game writes awaitingLaunchCode on standard output once it is ready to read; only then does the launcher request a launch code and write it, one line, to standard input. The game answers signedIn once the backend has redeemed the code, or failedPrefix, a space and one failure code. Every line ends with LF and never carries a secret; a launcher ignores any other line. The game (VeyraLaunchHandshake.h), veyra-devlaunch (Backend) and the launcher (Launcher/) test their copies against this file.
